name: PagePack — Offline Web Clipper
description: Save complete web pages to a private, on-device library for reliable offline reading.

content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none';
